name: Hook Horror Lair
place: Hook Horror Hunt — a hook horror lair in the tunnels (Out of the Abyss, ch. 2 Into Darkness, p.33)
intro: Dark tunnels. Somewhere ahead, a clacking of claws on stone — and behind it, giggling.
_source: Out of the Abyss ch.2 'Hook Horror Hunt' (print p.33; campaign_chunks ids 1259, 1260, 1262, 1263). Areas: 1 second entrance where the party arrives; 2A gnoll hunters (four gnolls); 2B the rest of the hunt (four gnolls + gnoll pack lord carrying two bloodstones 50 gp and a brown tourmaline 100 gp); 3 Cornered — single-file passage into a dead-end cave where the pair of hook horrors wait in ambush and fight to the death, hole C in the 10-ft ceiling, DC 12 Strength (Athletics) up to 4; 4 Hook Horror Nest — four 1-ft rocky eggs half-buried in a sandy pit, 10% per hour one hatches; 5 Gnoll Camp — three gnolls guard the main entrance. P passages: Large creatures squeeze (1 extra ft per ft). The lair is completely dark. LAYOUT NOTE: the book's map is not ingested as an image; this grid is Claude's reading of the TEXT (which area joins which, what is narrow, what is a dead end), not a trace of the printed map — Sam can redraw it in the builder.
_startNote: The party wanders in from the second entrance at the west end of area 1 (p.33).

creatures._note: Area 1: the mated pair dash in from 2A toward 3; they attack only in self-defence and fear the gnolls more than the party (p.33). `wary` keeps them from hunting the party; they run for area 3 (their refuge) and turn to fight anything that follows them in (3. Cornered: ambush, fight to the death).

Area 2A: four gnolls, hunting; they cannot resist attacking anything that crosses their path, shrieking 'Sacrifices for Yeenoghu!' (p.33). Gnoll = SRD 5.1 stats (manifest.js); sprite Sam-approved 2026-10-25 (PixelLab e8bd020a).
Area 2B: four gnolls and the gnoll pack lord (p.33).

The gnoll pack lord carries two bloodstones worth 50 gp each and a brown tourmaline worth 100 gp (p.33) — searchable on his body. Sprite Sam-approved 2026-10-25 (PixelLab 188c9690). Stat block NOT in SRD 5.1 / not ingested: fights with the SRD gnoll's numbers until Sam supplies the Monster Manual block (manifest needsStats).
Area 5: the gnoll camp at the main entrance — three gnolls guard it and attack anything that is not gnoll coming out of the tunnels (p.33).

nests.label: The nest
nests.text: The sandy floor holds a clutch of four 1-foot eggs with rocky shells, half-buried in a shallow pit. Under a hand, one of them trembles.
nests._note: Area 4 (p.33). 10% per hour one hatches and the infant imprints on the first creature it sees — the hatch clock and the Hook Horror Maturation table (p.34) are not in the engine; the eggs are items the party can carry out.

climbs.label: the hole in the ceiling (Athletics DC 12)
climbs._note: Area 3: a hole in the 10-ft ceiling, marked C, DC 12 Strength (Athletics) to climb up into; it leads to area 4 (p.33).

climbs.label: the hole back down to the cave below
climbs._note: The way back down. The book gives no check for descending; none is rolled — Sam's call if one is wanted.

dressing._note: No lights: the lair is completely dark (p.33), so there are no '*' crystals on this map and no violet fungi. The party's own darkvision/light is what they get.
